- NSFDC does not take applications directly: "Direct contact or correspondence by applicants/beneficiaries is not entertained by NSFDC. All loan applications must be routed through authorized State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) or other Channelizing Agencies (CAs)."
- Offline applications go with "a valid caste certificate, income proof, KYC documents" and the agency's checklist.

### 7.2 Other schemes

**PM Vishwakarma is the best-fitting scheme for D19.** "Carpenter" is a covered trade: "The scheme also accommodated Vishwakarmas of various trades such as Raajmistri (Mason), Tailor, Garland Maker, Carpenter, and Cobbler." [S14] p.6

cells: The scheme gives "special attention to women empowerment and marginalised or underserved groups like the Scheduled Castes" [S14] p.2, and its loans are "collateral-free" [S14] p.4. "working with bare hands and tools"; "Engaged in one of the mentioned 18 family-based traditional trades"; "Minimum age should be 18 years on the date of registration"; "restricted to one member of the family only"; family member must "not be employed in government service". **Fits the Micro size (§2a) only.** The 12-person unit (§2b) likely fails the self-employment test ("Involved in the unorganized sector or self-employment basis") (our reading)

Toolkit "₹15,000 in the form of an e-voucher"; training "stipend of ₹500 per day"; loan "₹1 Lakhs" (18 months), condition "Basic training completed"; then "₹2 Lakhs" (30 months), conditions "Availed 1st tranche of loan", "Maintained standard loan account", "Adopted digital transactions in business, or undergone advanced training"; "Concessional rate of interest fixed at 5%"; "Re.1 per digital transaction", "up to a maximum of 100 transactions monthly"
Scheme outlay "from FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28". New registrations open now? ⚠

**Unclear ⚠.** "No loans should have been availed under a similar credit-based scheme of the Central/State government for self-employment/business development in the past 5 years." Which schemes count as "similar", and whether repaid loans are allowed: **NOT FOUND** here (the full guideline is not saved in `_shared/` ⚠). **App rule (our design choice):** show the NSFDC tier first (framework rule). Then show PM Vishwakarma as an option (5% vs NSFDC's 6.5%/8%) with the warning: "An NSFDC loan may count as a similar credit-based scheme and block PM Vishwakarma for 5 years.
